subject: GCP private offer — staged credits tied to MAP milestones
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: GCP private offer — MAP and credits

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to capture a clear mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align our internal eval milestones with a GCP private offer and a staged credit schedule. High level asks from our side:

- We need a 6-week evaluation runway (POC + load test) with an early commit option at week 4.
- Pricing steps tied to MAP milestones (week 2 pilot, week 4 commit, week 6 ramp).
- Staged invoice credits that offset initial usage during the eval and first paid month.
- GCP private offer submitted by Redwood Marketplace team so we can accept on our side.

Can you send a MAP draft that maps milestones to the private-offer pricing steps and the proposed credit schedule? We also need a single contact at Redwood who can push the private offer into GCP Marketplace once terms are agreed.

Jordan
Director, Cloud Platform — Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — MAP and credits

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) that ties the evaluation milestones to a staged private-offer pricing ladder and an invoice-credit schedule. Key points (TL;DR):

1) MAP milestones (6 weeks):
   - Week 0: Kickoff + credentials; Redwood enables eval tenant.
   - Week 2: Pilot acceptance (functional QA) — pricing stage A (baseline list price, 10% eval credit).
   - Week 4: Commit decision (signed Letter of Intent / acceptance of private offer) — pricing stage B (commit discount applied, additional invoice credit up to 30% of eval usage).
   - Week 6: Ramp to production (SLA start) — pricing stage C (final committed tier pricing; remaining credits applied to first invoice).

2) Credit mechanics:
   - Credits are issued as invoice adjustments tied to the GCP private offer ID; they apply against usage invoices for the first two billing cycles post-acceptance.
   - We propose a staged credit pool: 10% at pilot, 20% on commit, remaining up to agreed cap on ramp.

3) Private offer delivery: Redwood will create the private offer in GCP Marketplace; finalization requires Acme to accept the offer in your console. We will link credits to the offer ID so accounting reconciles cleanly.

I've copied Ben and Rishi to confirm discount bands and legal language for the private offer. If that looks right, I can schedule a short sync to finalize terms and then push the private offer to GCP.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: GCP private offer — MAP and credits (need pricing / legal signoff)

Ben / Rishi —

Looping you both for quick pricing/legal signoff. Acme wants staged credits tied to the private offer. Proposed bands in the draft:

- Stage A (pilot): no commit, list pricing; Redwood applies a one-time 10% invoice credit for pilot usage.
- Stage B (commit at week 4): 12-month minimum commitment; 18% commit discount to list; additional 20% credit applied up to a fixed cap; private offer reflects committed unit price.
- Stage C (production ramp at week 6): applied committed tier pricing; remaining credits applied to first full invoice following ramp.

Open items: final cap on credits (I proposed $75k), whether credit flows via invoice adjustment or Marketplace refund, and approval to create the private offer in GCP (we will need our Redwood Marketplace contact to submit).

Can you confirm quickly so I can get this back to Jordan?

—Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP private offer — MAP and credits (need pricing / legal signoff)

Marissa —

Thanks. I like the structure; small edits below:

- Keep the credit cap at $75k but make it refundable only via invoice adjustment linked to private offer ID (avoids Marketplace refunds).
- Commit tier: move to a 9-month minimum (vs 12) to help them expedite the LOI; keep the 18% commit discount but add a step-up option at 6 months if they materially exceed usage (performance-based rebate).
- Private offer workflow: authorize Marissa to create the draft offer in GCP; legal will run a quick review on the final terms before we submit.

Rishi — please confirm the legal banner language we need included (I think: credits apply only to usage invoices and do not constitute a cash refund; private offer acceptance triggers credit application).

Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com, GCP Marketplace <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — MAP and credits

Marissa / Ben —

This looks good and aligns with procurement constraints. Two quick asks before we finalize:

1) Can the credit cap be broken down by milestone (e.g., $15k at pilot, $30k on commit, $30k on ramp) so our finance team can map to internal approvals?
2) Please add the phrase Jordan requested: "credits apply against first two billing cycles post-acceptance and are not redeemable for cash."

If you can update the MAP_Draft_v1.pdf with those two bullets and share the draft private-offer file, we can get procurement to sign the LOI next week. Once we have the LOI, please proceed to create the private offer in GCP and share the DocuSign link for signature.

Jordan
Director, Cloud Platform — Acme Corp
